name: Ash Sharai

queries.query: Saudi Arabia official cadastral parcel map Ash Sharai Makkah land parcels geospatial portal
queries.result: Found first-party Saudi sources describing public geospatial parcel-map services: the National Geospatial Platform lists land parcels as a national layer; REGA describes a geospatial real-estate portal with land parcels and spatial search; the Ministry of Municipalities and Housing describes Urban Maps/U Maps as showing streets and land parcels.

queries.query: السعودية الشرائع مكة خريطة قطع الأراضي بوابة العقار الجيومكانية الخرائط الحضرية
queries.result: وجدت مصادر رسمية سعودية لبوابة العقار الجيومكانية والمنصة الجيومكانية الوطنية والخرائط الحضرية؛ وتذكر هذه المصادر قطع الأراضي والبحث المكاني. كما وجدت إعلان هيئة العقار عن التسجيل العيني في أجزاء من حي الشرائع بمكة، لكنه يثبت نطاق التسجيل العقاري فقط ولا يوفر استجابة هندسية عامة للقطع.

administrativeIdentity.cityContext: Ash Sharai / Al-Shara'i district of Makkah
administrativeIdentity.identityEvidence: The WUP record supplies the immutable point and city identity. First-party REGA material explicitly names part of حي الشرائع in Makkah among areas entering real-estate registration; this is contextual coverage evidence, not a parcel hit.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Saudi National Geospatial Platform land-parcel layer, REGA Geospatial Real Estate Portal, and Ministry/Balady Urban Maps parcel display/search services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official prose and current portal landing assets were verified. The National Geospatial Platform HTML identifies land parcels as a layer; the current geoportal HTML and JavaScript loaded over TLS. No anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.
coverageAssessment.exactPointHitInterpretation: No exact-point parcel request was executed because the inspected public landing configuration did not expose a safe anonymous parcel vector endpoint. This is not evidence of absence.

technicalBlocker: The REGA portal page returned HTTP 503 to a direct TLS-verified GET during this attempt. The National Geospatial Platform loaded its React shell and current JavaScript, but the bundle exposed catalog links rather than a usable anonymous parcel feature service. No credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or unsafe owner/address/title fields were used.
remainingUncertainty: The public parcel service endpoint, native parcel identifier semantics, CRS, exact Ash Sharai boundary correspondence, and whether parcel vectors are anonymously downloadable remain unresolved.
nextStep: Serial reviewer may independently inspect the current REGA/National Geospatial Platform or Balady U Maps application for a safe public ID-plus-geometry response; runtime admission remains held.
